text: Based on the tool output, there was indeed deforestation of native forest on the property in 2022. The observation tools detected a tree-cover loss event of 0.6 hectares, which corresponds to 3.41% of the asset's area. This event was observed in the year 2022 by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset. Additionally, the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset corroborated that the entire event area was mapped as forest in 2020. The MGAP forest map from 2021 identified that 0.5 hectares of the event area was native forest. Therefore, it can be concluded that native forest was deforested on the property in 2022.
